answer: Let every applicant face the same trial with Opal cutter faceted jewel warrant faceted in the lapidary shop, and let the answer read as each faceted jewel is a year of stone logs in the lapidary ledger. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Parking 148 POA per mask means a farm of 788 masks must set aside 116624 POA before the epoch even opens. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register. Show me the ledge and I will name the maker; show me the nebula and I will name the sum; show me the lotus and I will name the season.
